senses.zh_definition: Gadreel：《以诺一书》第69章出现的天使专名，该书叙事将其与引诱夏娃以及向人类传授致命武器知识联系起来。
senses.en_definition: Gadreel, an angel named in 1 Enoch 69 and associated in its narrative with leading Eve astray and revealing deadly weapons to humanity.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas malaikat dalam 1 Henokh bab 69 yang dikaitkan dalam kisah tersebut dengan penyesatan Hawa dan pengajaran penggunaan senjata maut kepada manusia.
senses.nuances: 这是专名说明，并非已核实的 DBP 马来语正式释义，因此 status 标为 unverified。规范书写用 Gadreel；词头保留输入小写。原始语境不足以判断输入是否指古代文献人物或后来的同名角色。以下搭配是说明性用例，不宣称为高频搭配。来源：[1 Enoch，第69章](https://sacred-texts.com/book/the-book-of-enoch/chapter-lxix)。frequency_rank 仅沿用输入排名。

etymology.historical_story: Gadreel belongs to the named angelic figures of Enochic literature rather than to an established Malay word family. In chapter 69, the narrative connects him with Eve's deception and humanity's knowledge of lethal weapons. This supplies a documented literary setting for the name, but does not establish a standardized Malay pronunciation or a verified ultimate etymology. [Source: 1 Enoch 69](https://sacred-texts.com/book/the-book-of-enoch/chapter-lxix).
